'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Mike Gemme LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Gemme]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Unleash The Beast
* '''Username:''' DECK 104
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
